mapper.select: select a.id, a.job_id, j.title jobTitle, j.company_id, c.name companyName, a.resume_id, r.name resumeName, a.status, a.interview_time interviewTime, a.remark, a.create_time createTime from application a join job j on a.job_id = j.id join company c on j.company_id = c.id join resume r on a.resume_id = r.id where a.user_id = #{userId} order by a.create_time desc
